+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ previous_halo,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ next_halo, int n, int local_rows,
+    int first_global_row, int local_row, int column) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_row) * n + column;
+    const int global_row = first_global_row + local_row;
+    const val_t center = energy[index];
+    val_t total = externalFlow(global_row, column, n);
+
+    // Preserve the original connection order: +row, -row, +column, -column.
+    if (global_row + 1 < n) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row + 1 < local_rows
+                                   ? energy[index + n]
+                                   : next_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (global_row > 0) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row > 0 ? energy[index - n]
+                                              : previous_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column + 1 < n) {
+        total += (energy[index + 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column > 0) {
+        total += (energy[index - 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+
+    next_energy[index] = center + total;
+    next_flux[index] = flux[index] + fabs(total);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateInteriorKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    int n, int local_rows, int first_global_row) {
+    const int column = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int local_row = 1 + blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (column >= n || local_row >= local_rows - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, nullptr, nullptr, n,
+                  local_rows, first_global_row, local_row, column);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateSingleRankKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux, int n) {
+    const int column = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int row = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (column >= n || row >= n) {
+        return;
+    }
+    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, nullptr, nullptr, n, n,
+                  0, row, column);
 }

+__global__ void updateBoundaryKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ previous_halo,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ next_halo, int n, int local_rows,
+    int first_global_row) {
+    const int linear = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int boundary_rows = local_rows == 1 ? 1 : 2;
+    if (linear >= n * boundary_rows) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const int side = linear / n;

+                  next_halo, n, local_rows, first_global_row, local_row,
+                  column);

+uint64_t computeLocalHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements,
+                          idx_t global_offset) {
+    uint64_t result = 0;
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : result)
+    for (int64_t local_index = 0;
+         local_index < static_cast<int64_t>(elements.size()); ++local_index) {
+        uint64_t energy_bits = 0;
+        uint64_t flux_bits = 0;
+        std::memcpy(&energy_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].current_energy,
+                    sizeof(energy_bits));
+        std::memcpy(&flux_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].total_flux,
+                    sizeof(flux_bits));
+        const uint64_t global_index =
+            global_offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(local_index);
+        result ^= (energy_bits + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+        result ^= (flux_bits + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;

+void checkMpi(int status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status == MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        return;
+    }
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+    char buffer[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING + 256];
+    std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "MPI call %s failed: %.*s", expression,
+                  length, message);
+    fatalError(buffer, file, line);
+}

+void checkCuda(cudaError_t status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {

+    char buffer[512];
+    std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "CUDA call %s failed: %s", expression,
+                  cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    fatalError(buffer, file, line);

+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ previous_halo,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ next_halo, int n, int local_rows,
+    int first_global_row, int local_row, int column) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_row) * n + column;
+    const int global_row = first_global_row + local_row;
+    const val_t center = energy[index];
+    val_t total = externalFlow(global_row, column, n);
+
+    // Preserve the original connection order: +row, -row, +column, -column.
+    if (global_row + 1 < n) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row + 1 < local_rows
+                                   ? energy[index + n]
+                                   : next_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (global_row > 0) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row > 0 ? energy[index - n]
+                                              : previous_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column + 1 < n) {
+        total += (energy[index + 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column > 0) {
+        total += (energy[index - 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+
+    next_energy[index] = center + total;
+    next_flux[index] = flux[index] + fabs(total);
+}

+        const size_t halo_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n_) * sizeof(val_t);
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&energy_, local_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&flux_, local_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&next_energy_, local_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&next_flux_, local_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&previous_halo_, halo_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&next_halo_, halo_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&halo_storage_, 4 * halo_bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+
+        send_previous_ = halo_storage_;
+        send_next_ = send_previous_ + n_;
+        receive_previous_ = send_next_ + n_;
+        receive_next_ = receive_previous_ + n_;
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&compute_stream_, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&communication_stream_,
+                                              cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&halos_ready_, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&iteration_ready_, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(energy_, 0, local_bytes, compute_stream_));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(flux_, 0, local_bytes, compute_stream_));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(iteration_ready_, compute_stream_));
+    }
+
+    DeviceSimulation(const DeviceSimulation&) = delete;
+    DeviceSimulation& operator=(const DeviceSimulation&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceSimulation() {
+        cudaEventDestroy(iteration_ready_);
+        cudaEventDestroy(halos_ready_);
+        cudaStreamDestroy(communication_stream_);
+        cudaStreamDestroy(compute_stream_);
+        cudaFreeHost(halo_storage_);
+        cudaFree(next_halo_);
+        cudaFree(previous_halo_);
+        cudaFree(next_flux_);
+        cudaFree(next_energy_);
+        cudaFree(flux_);
+        cudaFree(energy_);

+    void synchronize() {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(iteration_ready_));

+    void run(int iterations) {
+        const dim3 interior_threads(32, 8);
+        if (ranks_ == 1) {
+            const dim3 blocks((n_ + interior_threads.x - 1) / interior_threads.x,
+                              (n_ + interior_threads.y - 1) / interior_threads.y);
+            for (int iteration = 0; iteration < iterations; ++iteration) {
+                updateSingleRankKernel<<<blocks, interior_threads, 0,
+                                         compute_stream_>>>(
+                    energy_, flux_, next_energy_, next_flux_, n_);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+                std::swap(energy_, next_energy_);
+                std::swap(flux_, next_flux_);
+            }
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(iteration_ready_, compute_stream_));
+            synchronize();

+                                       interior_threads.x,

+                                             interior_threads.y

+                                    TAG_TO_PREVIOUS, MPI_COMM_WORLD,

+                                    TAG_TO_NEXT, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));

+                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                                           communication_stream_));
+            }

+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(compute_stream_, halos_ready_, 0));

+                                   compute_stream_>>>(

+                next_halo_, n_, slab_.rows, slab_.first_row);

+    std::vector<ElementDynamic> copyResultToHost() {

+uint64_t computeLocalHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements,
+                          idx_t global_offset) {
+    uint64_t result = 0;
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : result)
+    for (int64_t local_index = 0;
+         local_index < static_cast<int64_t>(elements.size()); ++local_index) {
+        uint64_t energy_bits = 0;
+        uint64_t flux_bits = 0;
+        std::memcpy(&energy_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].current_energy,
+                    sizeof(energy_bits));
+        std::memcpy(&flux_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].total_flux,
+                    sizeof(flux_bits));
+        const uint64_t global_index =
+            global_offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(local_index);
+        result ^= (energy_bits + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+        result ^= (flux_bits + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
     }
+    return result;
 }

+    std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "MPI call %s failed: %.*s", expression,
+                  length, message);

+                  cudaGetErrorString(status));

+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ previous_halo,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ next_halo, int n, int local_rows,
+    int first_global_row, int local_row, int column) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_row) * n + column;
+    const int global_row = first_global_row + local_row;
+    const val_t center = energy[index];
+    val_t total = externalFlow(global_row, column, n);
+
+    // Preserve the original connection order: +row, -row, +column, -column.
+    if (global_row + 1 < n) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row + 1 < local_rows
+                                   ? energy[index + n]
+                                   : next_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (global_row > 0) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row > 0 ? energy[index - n]
+                                              : previous_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column + 1 < n) {
+        total += (energy[index + 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column > 0) {
+        total += (energy[index - 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+
+    next_energy[index] = center + total;
+    next_flux[index] = flux[index] + fabs(total);
+}

+    const int local_row = 1 + blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;

+    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, nullptr, nullptr, n,
+                  local_rows, first_global_row, local_row, column);

+            if (request_count != 0) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+            }
+
+            if (rank_ > 0) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(previous_halo_, receive_previous_,
+                                           halo_bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                                           communication_stream_));
+            }
+            if (rank_ + 1 < ranks_) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(next_halo_, receive_next_, halo_bytes,
+                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                                           communication_stream_));
+            }
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(halos_ready_, communication_stream_));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(compute_stream_, halos_ready_, 0));
+
+            updateBoundaryKernel<<<boundary_blocks, boundary_threads, 0,
+                                   compute_stream_>>>(
+                energy_, flux_, next_energy_, next_flux_, previous_halo_,
+                next_halo_, n_, slab_.rows, slab_.first_row);

+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(iteration_ready_, compute_stream_));

+            std::swap(flux_, next_flux_);
+        }
+        synchronize();

+uint64_t computeLocalHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements,
+                          idx_t global_offset) {
+    uint64_t result = 0;
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : result)
+    for (int64_t local_index = 0;
+         local_index < static_cast<int64_t>(elements.size()); ++local_index) {
+        uint64_t energy_bits = 0;
+        uint64_t flux_bits = 0;
+        std::memcpy(&energy_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].current_energy,
+                    sizeof(energy_bits));
+        std::memcpy(&flux_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].total_flux,
+                    sizeof(flux_bits));
+        const uint64_t global_index =
+            global_offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(local_index);
+        result ^= (energy_bits + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+        result ^= (flux_bits + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
     }
+    return result;

+[[noreturn]] void fatalError(const char* what, const char* file, int line) {
+    int initialized = 0;
+    int rank = 0;
+    MPI_Initialized(&initialized);
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    }
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s at %s:%d\n", rank, what, file, line);
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    std::abort();

+void checkMpi(int status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status == MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        return;
+    }
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+    char buffer[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING + 256];
+    std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "MPI call %s failed: %.*s", expression,
+                  length, message);
+    fatalError(buffer, file, line);
+}
+
+void checkCuda(cudaError_t status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return;
+    }
+    char buffer[512];
+    std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "CUDA call %s failed: %s", expression,
+                  cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    fatalError(buffer, file, line);
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ previous_halo,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ next_halo, int n, int local_rows,
+    int first_global_row, int local_row, int column) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_row) * n + column;
+    const int global_row = first_global_row + local_row;
+    const val_t center = energy[index];
+    val_t total = externalFlow(global_row, column, n);
+
+    // Preserve the original connection order: +row, -row, +column, -column.
+    if (global_row + 1 < n) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row + 1 < local_rows
+                                   ? energy[index + n]
+                                   : next_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (global_row > 0) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row > 0 ? energy[index - n]
+                                              : previous_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column + 1 < n) {
+        total += (energy[index + 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column > 0) {
+        total += (energy[index - 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+
+    next_energy[index] = center + total;
+    next_flux[index] = flux[index] + fabs(total);
+}

+__global__ void updateInteriorKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    int n, int local_rows, int first_global_row) {
+    const int column = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int local_row = 1 + blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (column >= n || local_row >= local_rows - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, nullptr, nullptr, n,
+                  local_rows, first_global_row, local_row, column);
+}

+__global__ void updateSingleRankKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux, int n) {
+    const int column = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int row = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (column >= n || row >= n) {
+        return;
+    }
+    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, nullptr, nullptr, n, n,
+                  0, row, column);

+uint64_t computeLocalHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements,
+                          idx_t global_offset) {
+    uint64_t result = 0;
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : result)
+    for (int64_t local_index = 0;
+         local_index < static_cast<int64_t>(elements.size()); ++local_index) {
+        uint64_t energy_bits = 0;
+        uint64_t flux_bits = 0;
+        std::memcpy(&energy_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].current_energy,
+                    sizeof(energy_bits));
+        std::memcpy(&flux_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].total_flux,
+                    sizeof(flux_bits));
+        const uint64_t global_index =
+            global_offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(local_index);
+        result ^= (energy_bits + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+        result ^= (flux_bits + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;

+void checkMpi(int status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status == MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        return;
+    }
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+    char buffer[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING + 256];
+    std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "MPI call %s failed: %.*s", expression,
+                  length, message);
+    fatalError(buffer, file, line);
+}
+
+void checkCuda(cudaError_t status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return;
+    }
+    char buffer[512];
+    std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "CUDA call %s failed: %s", expression,
+                  cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    fatalError(buffer, file, line);
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ previous_halo,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ next_halo, int n, int local_rows,
+    int first_global_row, int local_row, int column) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_row) * n + column;
+    const int global_row = first_global_row + local_row;
+    const val_t center = energy[index];
+    val_t total = externalFlow(global_row, column, n);
+
+    // Preserve the original connection order: +row, -row, +column, -column.
+    if (global_row + 1 < n) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row + 1 < local_rows
+                                   ? energy[index + n]
+                                   : next_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (global_row > 0) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row > 0 ? energy[index - n]
+                                              : previous_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column + 1 < n) {
+        total += (energy[index + 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column > 0) {
+        total += (energy[index - 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+
+    next_energy[index] = center + total;
+    next_flux[index] = flux[index] + fabs(total);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateInteriorKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    int n, int local_rows, int first_global_row) {
+    const int column = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int local_row = 1 + blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (column >= n || local_row >= local_rows - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, nullptr, nullptr, n,
+                  local_rows, first_global_row, local_row, column);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateSingleRankKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux, int n) {
+    const int column = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int row = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (column >= n || row >= n) {
+        return;
+    }
+    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, nullptr, nullptr, n, n,
+                  0, row, column);
 }

+__global__ void updateBoundaryKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ previous_halo,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ next_halo, int n, int local_rows,
+    int first_global_row) {
+    const int linear = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int boundary_rows = local_rows == 1 ? 1 : 2;
+    if (linear >= n * boundary_rows) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const int side = linear / n;
+    const int column = linear - side * n;
+    const int local_row = side == 0 ? 0 : local_rows - 1;
+    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, previous_halo,
+                  next_halo, n, local_rows, first_global_row, local_row,
+                  column);

+uint64_t computeLocalHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements,
+                          idx_t global_offset) {
+    uint64_t result = 0;
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : result)
+    for (int64_t local_index = 0;
+         local_index < static_cast<int64_t>(elements.size()); ++local_index) {
+        uint64_t energy_bits = 0;
+        uint64_t flux_bits = 0;
+        std::memcpy(&energy_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].current_energy,
+                    sizeof(energy_bits));
+        std::memcpy(&flux_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].total_flux,
+                    sizeof(flux_bits));
+        const uint64_t global_index =
+            global_offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(local_index);
+        result ^= (energy_bits + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+        result ^= (flux_bits + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
     }
+    return result;

+void checkMpi(int status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {

+        return;
+    }
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+    char buffer[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING + 256];
+    std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "MPI call %s failed: %.*s", expression,
+                  length, message);
+    fatalError(buffer, file, line);
+}

+void checkCuda(cudaError_t status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {

+                  cudaGetErrorString(status));

+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ previous_halo,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ next_halo, int n, int local_rows,
+    int first_global_row, int local_row, int column) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_row) * n + column;
+    const int global_row = first_global_row + local_row;
+    const val_t center = energy[index];
+    val_t total = externalFlow(global_row, column, n);
+
+    // Preserve the original connection order: +row, -row, +column, -column.
+    if (global_row + 1 < n) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row + 1 < local_rows
+                                   ? energy[index + n]
+                                   : next_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (global_row > 0) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row > 0 ? energy[index - n]
+                                              : previous_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column + 1 < n) {
+        total += (energy[index + 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column > 0) {
+        total += (energy[index - 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+
+    next_energy[index] = center + total;
+    next_flux[index] = flux[index] + fabs(total);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateInteriorKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    int n, int local_rows, int first_global_row) {
+    const int column = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int local_row = 1 + blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (column >= n || local_row >= local_rows - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, nullptr, nullptr, n,
+                  local_rows, first_global_row, local_row, column);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateSingleRankKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux, int n) {
+    const int column = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int row = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (column >= n || row >= n) {

+uint64_t computeLocalHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements,
+                          idx_t global_offset) {
+    uint64_t result = 0;
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : result)
+    for (int64_t local_index = 0;
+         local_index < static_cast<int64_t>(elements.size()); ++local_index) {
+        uint64_t energy_bits = 0;
+        uint64_t flux_bits = 0;

+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].current_energy,
+                    sizeof(energy_bits));

+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].total_flux,
+                    sizeof(flux_bits));
+        const uint64_t global_index =
+            global_offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(local_index);
+        result ^= (energy_bits + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+        result ^= (flux_bits + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;

+    return result;

+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ previous_halo,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ next_halo, int n, int local_rows,
+    int first_global_row, int local_row, int column) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_row) * n + column;
+    const int global_row = first_global_row + local_row;
+    const val_t center = energy[index];
+    val_t total = externalFlow(global_row, column, n);
+
+    // Preserve the original connection order: +row, -row, +column, -column.
+    if (global_row + 1 < n) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row + 1 < local_rows
+                                   ? energy[index + n]
+                                   : next_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (global_row > 0) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row > 0 ? energy[index - n]
+                                              : previous_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column + 1 < n) {
+        total += (energy[index + 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column > 0) {
+        total += (energy[index - 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+
+    next_energy[index] = center + total;
+    next_flux[index] = flux[index] + fabs(total);
+}

+uint64_t computeLocalHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements,
+                          idx_t global_offset) {
+    uint64_t result = 0;
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : result)
+    for (int64_t local_index = 0;
+         local_index < static_cast<int64_t>(elements.size()); ++local_index) {
+        uint64_t energy_bits = 0;
+        uint64_t flux_bits = 0;
+        std::memcpy(&energy_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].current_energy,
+                    sizeof(energy_bits));
+        std::memcpy(&flux_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].total_flux,
+                    sizeof(flux_bits));
+        const uint64_t global_index =
+            global_offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(local_index);
+        result ^= (energy_bits + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+        result ^= (flux_bits + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
     }
+    return result;
 }

   105	__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(
   106	    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
   107	    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
   108	    const val_t* __restrict__ previous_halo,
   109	    const val_t* __restrict__ next_halo, int n, int local_rows,
   110	    int first_global_row, int local_row, int column) {
   111	    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_row) * n + column;
   112	    const int global_row = first_global_row + local_row;
   113	    const val_t center = energy[index];
   114	    val_t total = externalFlow(global_row, column, n);
   115	
   116	    // Preserve the original connection order: +row, -row, +column, -column.
   117	    if (global_row + 1 < n) {
   118	        const val_t neighbor = local_row + 1 < local_rows
   119	                                   ? energy[index + n]
   120	                                   : next_halo[column];
   121	        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
   122	    }
   123	    if (global_row > 0) {
   124	        const val_t neighbor = local_row > 0 ? energy[index - n]
   125	                                              : previous_halo[column];
   126	        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
   127	    }
   128	    if (column + 1 < n) {
   129	        total += (energy[index + 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
   130	                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
   131	    }
   132	    if (column > 0) {
   133	        total += (energy[index - 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
   134	                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
   135	    }
   136	
   137	    next_energy[index] = center + total;
   138	    next_flux[index] = flux[index] + fabs(total);
   139	}
   140	
   141	__global__ void updateInteriorKernel(
   142	    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
   143	    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
   144	    int n, int local_rows, int first_global_row) {
   145	    const int column = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   146	    const int local_row = 1 + blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
   147	    if (column >= n || local_row >= local_rows - 1) {
   148	        return;
   149	    }
   150	    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, nullptr, nullptr, n,
   151	                  local_rows, first_global_row, local_row, column);
   152	}
   153	
   154	__global__ void updateSingleRankKernel(
   155	    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
   156	    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux, int n) {
   157	    const int column = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   158	    const int row = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
   159	    if (column >= n || row >= n) {
   160	        return;
   161	    }
   162	    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, nullptr, nullptr, n, n,
   163	                  0, row, column);
   164	}
   165	
   166	__global__ void updateBoundaryKernel(
   167	    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
   168	    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
   169	    const val_t* __restrict__ previous_halo,
   170	    const val_t* __restrict__ next_halo, int n, int local_rows,
   171	    int first_global_row) {
   172	    const int linear = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   173	    const int boundary_rows = local_rows == 1 ? 1 : 2;
   174	    if (linear >= n * boundary_rows) {
   175	        return;
   176	    }
   177	    const int side = linear / n;
   178	    const int column = linear - side * n;
   179	    const int local_row = side == 0 ? 0 : local_rows - 1;
   180	    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, previous_halo,
   181	                  next_halo, n, local_rows, first_global_row, local_row,
   182	                  column);
   183	}

   185	class DeviceSimulation {
   186	public:
   187	    DeviceSimulation(int n, Slab slab, int rank, int ranks)
   188	        : n_(n), slab_(slab), rank_(rank), ranks_(ranks),
   189	          elements_(static_cast<size_t>(n) * slab.rows) {
   190	        const size_t local_bytes = elements_ * sizeof(val_t);
   191	        const size_t halo_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n_) * sizeof(val_t);
   192	
   193	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&energy_, local_bytes));
   194	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&flux_, local_bytes));
   195	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&next_energy_, local_bytes));
   196	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&next_flux_, local_bytes));
   197	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&previous_halo_, halo_bytes));
   198	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&next_halo_, halo_bytes));
   199	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&halo_storage_, 4 * halo_bytes,
   200	                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
   201	
   202	        send_previous_ = halo_storage_;
   203	        send_next_ = send_previous_ + n_;
   204	        receive_previous_ = send_next_ + n_;
   205	        receive_next_ = receive_previous_ + n_;
   206	
   207	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&compute_stream_, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   208	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&communication_stream_,
   209	                                              cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   210	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&halos_ready_, cudaEventDisableTiming));
   211	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&iteration_ready_, cudaEventDisableTiming));
   212	
   213	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(energy_, 0, local_bytes, compute_stream_));
   214	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(flux_, 0, local_bytes, compute_stream_));
   215	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(iteration_ready_, compute_stream_));
   216	    }
   217	
   218	    DeviceSimulation(const DeviceSimulation&) = delete;
   219	    DeviceSimulation& operator=(const DeviceSimulation&) = delete;
   220	
   221	    ~DeviceSimulation() {
   222	        cudaEventDestroy(iteration_ready_);
   223	        cudaEventDestroy(halos_ready_);
   224	        cudaStreamDestroy(communication_stream_);
   225	        cudaStreamDestroy(compute_stream_);
   226	        cudaFreeHost(halo_storage_);
   227	        cudaFree(next_halo_);
   228	        cudaFree(previous_halo_);
   229	        cudaFree(next_flux_);
   230	        cudaFree(next_energy_);
   231	        cudaFree(flux_);
   232	        cudaFree(energy_);
   233	    }
   234	
   235	    void synchronize() {
   236	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(iteration_ready_));
   237	    }
   238	
   239	    void run(int iterations) {
   240	        const dim3 interior_threads(32, 8);
   241	        if (ranks_ == 1) {
   242	            const dim3 blocks((n_ + interior_threads.x - 1) / interior_threads.x,
   243	                              (n_ + interior_threads.y - 1) / interior_threads.y);
   244	            for (int iteration = 0; iteration < iterations; ++iteration) {
   245	                updateSingleRankKernel<<<blocks, interior_threads, 0,
   246	                                         compute_stream_>>>(
   247	                    energy_, flux_, next_energy_, next_flux_, n_);
   248	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   249	                std::swap(energy_, next_energy_);
   250	                std::swap(flux_, next_flux_);
   251	            }
   252	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(iteration_ready_, compute_stream_));
   253	            synchronize();
   254	            return;
   255	        }
   256	
   257	        constexpr int boundary_threads = 256;
   258	        const dim3 interior_blocks((n_ + interior_threads.x - 1) /
   259	                                       interior_threads.x,
   260	                                   slab_.rows > 2
   261	                                       ? (slab_.rows - 2 + interior_threads.y - 1) /
   262	                                             interior_threads.y
   263	                                       : 0);
   264	        const int boundary_rows = slab_.rows == 1 ? 1 : 2;
   265	        const int boundary_blocks =
   266	            (n_ * boundary_rows + boundary_threads - 1) / boundary_threads;
   267	        const size_t halo_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n_) * sizeof(val_t);
   268	
   269	        for (int iteration = 0; iteration < iterations; ++iteration) {
   270	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(communication_stream_, iteration_ready_, 0));
   271	
   272	            MPI_Request requests[4];
   273	            int request_count = 0;
   274	            if (rank_ > 0) {
   275	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(receive_previous_, n_, MPI_DOUBLE, rank_ - 1,
   276	                                    TAG_TO_NEXT, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   277	                                    &requests[request_count++]));
   278	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(send_previous_, energy_, halo_bytes,
   279	                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
   280	                                           communication_stream_));
   281	            }
   282	            if (rank_ + 1 < ranks_) {
   283	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(receive_next_, n_, MPI_DOUBLE, rank_ + 1,
   284	                                    TAG_TO_PREVIOUS, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   285	                                    &requests[request_count++]));
   286	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(
   287	                    send_next_, energy_ + static_cast<size_t>(slab_.rows - 1) * n_,
   288	                    halo_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, communication_stream_));
   289	            }
   290	
   291	            if (slab_.rows > 2) {
   292	                updateInteriorKernel<<<interior_blocks, interior_threads, 0,
   293	                                       compute_stream_>>>(
   294	                    energy_, flux_, next_energy_, next_flux_, n_, slab_.rows,
   295	                    slab_.first_row);
   296	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   297	            }
   298	
   299	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(communication_stream_));
   300	            if (rank_ > 0) {
   301	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send_previous_, n_, MPI_DOUBLE, rank_ - 1,
   302	                                    TAG_TO_PREVIOUS, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   303	                                    &requests[request_count++]));
   304	            }
   305	            if (rank_ + 1 < ranks_) {
   306	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send_next_, n_, MPI_DOUBLE, rank_ + 1,
   307	                                    TAG_TO_NEXT, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   308	                                    &requests[request_count++]));
   309	            }
   310	            if (request_count != 0) {
   311	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
   312	            }
   313	
   314	            if (rank_ > 0) {
   315	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(previous_halo_, receive_previous_,
   316	                                           halo_bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
   317	                                           communication_stream_));
   318	            }
   319	            if (rank_ + 1 < ranks_) {
   320	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(next_halo_, receive_next_, halo_bytes,
   321	                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
   322	                                           communication_stream_));
   323	            }
   324	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(halos_ready_, communication_stream_));
   325	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(compute_stream_, halos_ready_, 0));
   326	
   327	            updateBoundaryKernel<<<boundary_blocks, boundary_threads, 0,
   328	                                   compute_stream_>>>(
   329	                energy_, flux_, next_energy_, next_flux_, previous_halo_,
   330	                next_halo_, n_, slab_.rows, slab_.first_row);
   331	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   332	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(iteration_ready_, compute_stream_));
   333	
   334	            std::swap(energy_, next_energy_);
   335	            std::swap(flux_, next_flux_);
   350	        for (int64_t i = 0; i < static_cast<int64_t>(elements_); ++i) {
   351	            result[static_cast<size_t>(i)] =
   352	                ElementDynamic{host_energy[static_cast<size_t>(i)],
   353	                               host_flux[static_cast<size_t>(i)]};
   354	        }
   355	        return result;
   356	    }
   357	
   358	private:
   359	    int n_;
   360	    Slab slab_;
   361	    int rank_;
   362	    int ranks_;
   363	    size_t elements_;
   364	    val_t* energy_ = nullptr;
   365	    val_t* flux_ = nullptr;
   366	    val_t* next_energy_ = nullptr;
   367	    val_t* next_flux_ = nullptr;
   368	    val_t* previous_halo_ = nullptr;
   369	    val_t* next_halo_ = nullptr;
   370	    val_t* halo_storage_ = nullptr;
   371	    val_t* send_previous_ = nullptr;
   372	    val_t* send_next_ = nullptr;
   373	    val_t* receive_previous_ = nullptr;
   374	    val_t* receive_next_ = nullptr;
   375	    cudaStream_t compute_stream_{};
   376	    cudaStream_t communication_stream_{};
   377	    cudaEvent_t halos_ready_{};
   378	    cudaEvent_t iteration_ready_{};
   379	};

   381	uint64_t computeLocalHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements,
   382	                          idx_t global_offset) {
   383	    uint64_t result = 0;
   384	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : result)
   385	    for (int64_t local_index = 0;
   386	         local_index < static_cast<int64_t>(elements.size()); ++local_index) {
   387	        uint64_t energy_bits = 0;
   388	        uint64_t flux_bits = 0;
   389	        std::memcpy(&energy_bits,
   390	                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].current_energy,
   391	                    sizeof(energy_bits));
   392	        std::memcpy(&flux_bits,
   393	                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].total_flux,
   394	                    sizeof(flux_bits));
   395	        const uint64_t global_index =
   396	            global_offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(local_index);
   397	        result ^= (energy_bits + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
   398	        result ^= (flux_bits + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
   399	    }
   400	    return result;
   401	}

   403	bool validateResults(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& local_elements,
   404	                     int rank) {
   405	    val_t local_energy_sum = 0.0;
   406	    val_t local_flux_sum = 0.0;
   407	    val_t local_energy_max = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();
   408	    val_t local_energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
   409	
   410	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : local_energy_sum, local_flux_sum) \
   411	    reduction(max : local_energy_max) reduction(min : local_energy_min)
   412	    for (int64_t i = 0; i < static_cast<int64_t>(local_elements.size()); ++i) {
   413	        const ElementDynamic& element = local_elements[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
   414	        local_energy_sum += element.current_energy;
   415	        local_flux_sum += element.total_flux;
   416	        local_energy_max = std::max(local_energy_max, element.current_energy);
   417	        local_energy_min = std::min(local_energy_min, element.current_energy);
   418	    }
   419	
   420	    val_t energy_sum = 0.0;
   421	    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;
   422	    val_t energy_max = 0.0;
   423	    val_t energy_min = 0.0;
   424	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_sum, &energy_sum, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0,
   425	                         MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   426	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_flux_sum, &flux_sum, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0,
   427	                         MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   428	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_max, &energy_max, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0,
   429	                         MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   430	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_min, &energy_min, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, 0,
   431	                         MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   432	
   433	    int valid = 1;
   434	    if (rank == 0) {
   435	        std::printf("Validation results:\n");
   436	        std::printf("  Energy sum: %.12f\n", energy_sum);
   437	        std::printf("  Flux sum: %.2f\n", flux_sum);
   438	        std::printf("  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", energy_min, energy_max);
   439	
   440	        constexpr val_t energy_epsilon = 1e-8;
   441	        if (!std::isfinite(energy_sum)) {
   442	            std::printf("  ERROR: Energy sum is not finite\n");
   443	            valid = 0;
   444	        } else if (std::abs(energy_sum) > energy_epsilon) {
   445	            std::printf("  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected conservation)\n");
   446	        }
   447	        if (!std::isfinite(flux_sum)) {
   448	            std::printf("  ERROR: Flux sum is not finite\n");
   449	            valid = 0;
   450	        }
   451	        if (!std::isfinite(energy_max) || !std::isfinite(energy_min)) {
   452	            std::printf("  ERROR: Energy extrema are not finite\n");
   453	            valid = 0;
   454	        }
   455	        if (valid) {
   456	            std::printf("  Validation: PASSED\n");
   457	        }
   458	    }
   459	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   460	    return valid != 0;
   461	}

   463	void printDistributedResults(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& local_elements,
   464	                             int n, int rank, int ranks) {
   465	    const int local_count = static_cast<int>(local_elements.size());
   466	    std::vector<val_t> local_energy(local_elements.size());
   467	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   468	    for (int64_t i = 0; i < static_cast<int64_t>(local_elements.size()); ++i) {
   469	        local_energy[static_cast<size_t>(i)] =
   470	            local_elements[static_cast<size_t>(i)].current_energy;
   471	    }
   472	
   473	    std::vector<int> counts;
   474	    std::vector<int> displacements;
   475	    std::vector<val_t> global_energy;
   476	    if (rank == 0) {
   477	        counts.resize(ranks);
   478	        displacements.resize(ranks);
   479	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   480	        for (int r = 0; r < ranks; ++r) {
   481	            const Slab slab = getSlab(n, r, ranks);
   482	            counts[r] = slab.rows * n;
   483	            displacements[r] = slab.first_row * n;
   484	        }
   485	        global_energy.resize(static_cast<size_t>(n) * n);
   486	    }
   487	
   488	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(local_energy.data(), local_count, MPI_DOUBLE,
   489	                          rank == 0 ? global_energy.data() : nullptr,
   490	                          rank == 0 ? counts.data() : nullptr,
   491	                          rank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE,
   492	                          0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   493	    if (rank == 0) {
   494	        print_results(global_energy, "ElementEnergy");
   495	    }
   496	}

   508	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   509	    int provided_thread_level = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
   510	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED,
   511	                              &provided_thread_level));
   512	    int rank = 0;
   513	    int ranks = 1;
   514	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank));
   515	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &ranks));
   516	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_RETURN));
   517	    if (provided_thread_level < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
   518	        fatalError("MPI does not provide MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED", __FILE__, __LINE__);
   519	    }
   520	
   521	    int n = 512;
   522	    int iterations = 10;
   523	    bool validate = false;
   524	    bool print_results_requested = false;
   525	    bool arguments_valid = true;
   526	    bool show_help = false;
   527	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   528	        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   529	            n = std::atoi(argv[++i]);
   530	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-i") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   531	            iterations = std::atoi(argv[++i]);
   532	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   533	            validate = true;
   534	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
   535	            print_results_requested = true;
   536	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   537	            show_help = true;
   538	        } else {
   539	            if (rank == 0) {
   540	                std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   541	            }
   542	            arguments_valid = false;
   543	        }
   544	    }
   545	    if (show_help || !arguments_valid) {
   546	        if (rank == 0) {
   547	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   548	        }
   549	        MPI_Finalize();
   550	        return arguments_valid ? 0 : 1;
   551	    }
   552	    if (n <= 0 || iterations < 0 || n < ranks ||
   553	        static_cast<int64_t>(n) * n > std::numeric_limits<int>::max()) {
   554	        if (rank == 0) {
   555	            std::fprintf(stderr,
   556	                         "Grid size must be positive, at least the MPI rank count, "
   557	                         "and contain at most INT_MAX elements; iterations must be "
   558	                         "non-negative.\n");

   573	    }

   583	    const size_t local_halo_memory = static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t) * 6;

   593	                    "CUDA GPUs\n", ranks, omp_get_max_threads());

+[[noreturn]] void fatalError(const char* what, const char* file, int line) {
+    int initialized = 0;
+    int rank = 0;

+    if (initialized) {

+void checkMpi(int status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status == MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        return;
+    }
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+    char buffer[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING + 256];
+    std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "MPI call %s failed: %.*s", expression,
+                  length, message);
+    fatalError(buffer, file, line);
+}
+
+void checkCuda(cudaError_t status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return;
+    }
+    char buffer[512];
+    std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "CUDA call %s failed: %s", expression,
+                  cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    fatalError(buffer, file, line);
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ previous_halo,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ next_halo, int n, int local_rows,
+    int first_global_row, int local_row, int column) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_row) * n + column;
+    const int global_row = first_global_row + local_row;
+    const val_t center = energy[index];
+    val_t total = externalFlow(global_row, column, n);
+
+    // Preserve the original connection order: +row, -row, +column, -column.
+    if (global_row + 1 < n) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row + 1 < local_rows
+                                   ? energy[index + n]
+                                   : next_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (global_row > 0) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row > 0 ? energy[index - n]
+                                              : previous_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column + 1 < n) {
+        total += (energy[index + 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column > 0) {
+        total += (energy[index - 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+
+    next_energy[index] = center + total;
+    next_flux[index] = flux[index] + fabs(total);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateInteriorKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    int n, int local_rows, int first_global_row) {
+    const int column = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int local_row = 1 + blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (column >= n || local_row >= local_rows - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, nullptr, nullptr, n,
+                  local_rows, first_global_row, local_row, column);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateSingleRankKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux, int n) {
+    const int column = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int row = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (column >= n || row >= n) {
+        return;
+    }
+    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, nullptr, nullptr, n, n,
+                  0, row, column);
 }

+class DeviceSimulation {
+public:
+    DeviceSimulation(int n, Slab slab, int rank, int ranks)
+        : n_(n), slab_(slab), rank_(rank), ranks_(ranks),
+          elements_(static_cast<size_t>(n) * slab.rows) {
+        const size_t local_bytes = elements_ * sizeof(val_t);
+        const size_t halo_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n_) * sizeof(val_t);
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&energy_, local_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&flux_, local_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&next_energy_, local_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&next_flux_, local_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&previous_halo_, halo_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&next_halo_, halo_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&halo_storage_, 4 * halo_bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+
+        send_previous_ = halo_storage_;
+        send_next_ = send_previous_ + n_;
+        receive_previous_ = send_next_ + n_;
+        receive_next_ = receive_previous_ + n_;
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&compute_stream_, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&communication_stream_,
+                                              cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&halos_ready_, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&iteration_ready_, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(energy_, 0, local_bytes, compute_stream_));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(flux_, 0, local_bytes, compute_stream_));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(iteration_ready_, compute_stream_));
+    }
+
+    DeviceSimulation(const DeviceSimulation&) = delete;
+    DeviceSimulation& operator=(const DeviceSimulation&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceSimulation() {
+        cudaEventDestroy(iteration_ready_);
+        cudaEventDestroy(halos_ready_);
+        cudaStreamDestroy(communication_stream_);
+        cudaStreamDestroy(compute_stream_);
+        cudaFreeHost(halo_storage_);
+        cudaFree(next_halo_);
+        cudaFree(previous_halo_);
+        cudaFree(next_flux_);
+        cudaFree(next_energy_);
+        cudaFree(flux_);
+        cudaFree(energy_);
+    }
+
+    void synchronize() {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(iteration_ready_));
+    }
+
+    void run(int iterations) {
+        const dim3 interior_threads(32, 8);
+        if (ranks_ == 1) {
+            const dim3 blocks((n_ + interior_threads.x - 1) / interior_threads.x,
+                              (n_ + interior_threads.y - 1) / interior_threads.y);
+            for (int iteration = 0; iteration < iterations; ++iteration) {
+                updateSingleRankKernel<<<blocks, interior_threads, 0,
+                                         compute_stream_>>>(
+                    energy_, flux_, next_energy_, next_flux_, n_);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+                std::swap(energy_, next_energy_);
+                std::swap(flux_, next_flux_);

+uint64_t computeLocalHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements,
+                          idx_t global_offset) {
+    uint64_t result = 0;
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : result)
+    for (int64_t local_index = 0;
+         local_index < static_cast<int64_t>(elements.size()); ++local_index) {
+        uint64_t energy_bits = 0;
+        uint64_t flux_bits = 0;
+        std::memcpy(&energy_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].current_energy,
+                    sizeof(energy_bits));
+        std::memcpy(&flux_bits,
+                    &elements[static_cast<size_t>(local_index)].total_flux,
+                    sizeof(flux_bits));
+        const uint64_t global_index =
+            global_offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(local_index);
+        result ^= (energy_bits + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+        result ^= (flux_bits + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
     }
+    return result;
 }

Key changes:

- MPI row-slab domain decomposition with nonblocking halo exchange.
- CUDA structure-of-arrays stencil kernels.

- Bitwise-compatible update ordering and result hashes.

+    int initialized = 0;

+void checkMpi(int status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status == MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        return;
+    }
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+    char buffer[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING + 256];
+    std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "MPI call %s failed: %.*s", expression,
+                  length, message);
+    fatalError(buffer, file, line);
+}

+void checkCuda(cudaError_t status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return;

+    char buffer[512];
+    std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "CUDA call %s failed: %s", expression,
+                  cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    fatalError(buffer, file, line);

+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ previous_halo,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ next_halo, int n, int local_rows,
+    int first_global_row, int local_row, int column) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_row) * n + column;
+    const int global_row = first_global_row + local_row;
+    const val_t center = energy[index];
+    val_t total = externalFlow(global_row, column, n);
+
+    // Preserve the original connection order: +row, -row, +column, -column.
+    if (global_row + 1 < n) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row + 1 < local_rows
+                                   ? energy[index + n]
+                                   : next_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (global_row > 0) {
+        const val_t neighbor = local_row > 0 ? energy[index - n]
+                                              : previous_halo[column];
+        total += (neighbor - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF * CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column + 1 < n) {
+        total += (energy[index + 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+    if (column > 0) {
+        total += (energy[index - 1] - center) * TRANSFER_COEFF *
+                 CONNECTION_FLUX * FLUX_SCALE;
+    }
+
+    next_energy[index] = center + total;
+    next_flux[index] = flux[index] + fabs(total);
+}

+__global__ void updateInteriorKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy, const val_t* __restrict__ flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy, val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+    int n, int local_rows, int first_global_row) {
+    const int column = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int local_row = 1 + blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (column >= n || local_row >= local_rows - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+    updateElement(energy, flux, next_energy, next_flux, nullptr, nullptr, n,
+                  local_rows, first_global_row, local_row, column);
+}

+uint64_t computeLocalHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements,
+                          idx_t global_offset) {

+         local_index < static_cast<int64_t>(elements.size()); ++local_index) {

Implemented the hybrid MPI/OpenMP/CUDA version while retaining the `unstructured` executable name.

Key changes:

- MPI row-slab domain decomposition with nonblocking halo exchange.
- CUDA structure-of-arrays stencil kernels.
- Overlapped interior GPU computation and pinned-memory halo transfers.
- Automatic node-local MPI rank-to-GPU assignment.
- OpenMP-parallel host result processing, validation, and hashing.
- Bitwise-compatible update ordering and result hashes.
- Updated CUDA/MPI/OpenMP CMake configuration.
